name: b0-policy-v3
description: Phase-3 B0 ObjectNav baseline: initial spin, frontier exploration, goal confirmation per b0-detection-v1, approach to stop_distance_m of the object's observed points, face, verify on one arrival frame, STOP. Detector = runtime YOLOE-26m worker of the v11 profile, latency charged in simulated time. No 3DSG, no tour, no room labels. Stop rule from runs/objectnav/b0/stop_calibration.json (DEV, 11/11): stop within 0.4 m of the observed points (P(success | reached) 0.93; 0.97 at 0.3 m); if no traversable cell that close is known, stop on the closest reachable cell when within 0.9 m (P 0.88 overall, but 0.45-0.55 for toilet and tv_monitor). v2 (12/11/2026): ESCAPE state - after 3 s without pose change in SPIN/EXPLORE/APPROACH, either back away from obstacles inside the safety margin (escape_step / escape_rotate, checked by the guard) or turn about 80 deg and re-plan; at most 10 per episode. Run with configs/objectnav/lockstep-b0-v2.json. v3 (12/11/2026, after the dev2-diag rerun): a clearance escape ends as soon as the planner's footprint mask holds the robot's own cell (Navigator.start_traversable) instead of a fixed 0.3375 m clearance (narrow corridors); a second escape at the same spot (within 0.15 m) after a turn did not help uses short guard-checked escape steps ('nudge', up to 0.10 m) instead of another turn; in APPROACH, 5 consecutive 'goal_reached' while beyond the stop distance reject the candidate (approach_goal_reached_far); an escape no longer restarts the 60 s approach timeout. Guard and actuation semantics unchanged. Run with configs/objectnav/lockstep-b0-v2.json.
